title: Enforce assignee-safe task claiming
description: Change task next --agent semantics so it never claims work assigned to a different agent unless an explicit future override such as --steal is introduced. Update scheduler logic, CLI/docs wording, and tests that cover assigned, unassigned, and foreign-assigned ready tasks. Keep flat-file backend as the only supported execution path; Trello and other providers remain future work.

comments.author: Codex
comments.message: Restricted task next --agent to matching-assignee or unassigned tasks, added scheduler coverage for foreign-assigned tasks and no-agent claims, and updated CLI/docs wording. Verified with go test ./...
